answer: Latency-Bridge Quota Gate: each new identity must pass a bridge through a relay that delays first traffic by a randomized interval drawn from a yarrow-shaped distribution, so burst arrival clusters smear across epochs. Agents whose early packets arrive faster than the tail permits get throttled to one request per epoch. An attacker must rent sustained low-rate capacity across many epochs per identity, like spreading a nebula thin, multiplying infrastructure cost by the number of identities.
